name: Find Project
query: Find my AI Research project and tell me its current details
context: The authenticated user has access to several projects. One project is named 'AI Research'. Other projects include 'AI Research Archive', 'Robotics Research', and 'Research Platform'. The exact project_id is not provided. The user wants to inspect the current project details without changing anything.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that the request is read-only project discovery
Uses get_projects to retrieve projects accessible to the authenticated user
Identifies the project named 'AI Research' from the returned results
Uses the actual project information returned by the MCP server
Does not call create_project or update_project
Does not provide user_id to the MCP tool
Returns relevant project details available from the MCP response
Does not expose internal authentication or login fields
success_criteria: The correct AI Research project is identified
The model uses get_projects rather than an invented get_project tool
The response is based on actual MCP results
The model does not confuse AI Research with AI Research Archive
No user_id or authentication data is exposed
